Limit[n=10]
  Sort[keys=total_revenue DESC]
    Project[p.brand AS brand, line_count, total_qty, total_revenue, avg_discount]
      Filter[sum(l.quantity) > 50]
        Aggregate[group=p.brand, aggs=count(*) AS line_count, sum(l.quantity) AS total_qty, sum(l.extended_price) AS total_revenue, avg(l.discount) AS avg_discount]
          Filter[o.order_status = 'O' AND p.size > 5]
            Join[kind=inner, cond=l.part_id = p.id]
              Join[kind=inner, cond=l.order_id = o.id]
                Scan[lineitem]
                Scan[orders]
              Scan[part]
